name: Yotsufuji Yoriko
source:
She is a housekeeper who manages all the household chores at the Kirishima family's villa. She is also in charge of making the sacred ropes that Kazuki uses in his rituals. 
She is a good cook and can make almost anything that is requested, as long as she has the ingredients and time. 
She is usually calm and kind, but when it comes to matters related to the Kirishima family's rituals, she becomes hysterical and transforms into a different person. 
She knows nothing about Mimasaka and the others' true nature or the "game," and thinks they are Kazuki's friends.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/PigeonBlood]Wikipedia[/url]]
